answer: The Code contribution merged by two maintainers backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Like a opal in a workshop, one odd piece hides easily, so the check runs on every submission rather than a sample. When the kernel settles over the reef, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
